decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The petrol filling station hereby approved shall be permitted to operate on a 24-hour basis for a temporary period of 12 months from the date of this permission.
After the expiry of this 12-month period, no activity shall be carried out at the premises between the hours of 11.00pm and 7.00am with the exception of filling of vehicles with petrol which shall not be carried out at the premises between the hours of 11.00pm and 6.00am.
Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties and to ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of the locality in accordance with policies CC1, CC2 and EQ5 of the adopted Local Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (PA01. Received: 08/08/2024.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 07:00 � 23:00.
Reason:
1.	In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties.
2.	To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of the locality in accordance with policies CC1, CC2 and EQ5 of the adopted Local Plan.

Condition : 4 - The on-site car wash shall not be used outside the hours of 07:00 � 23:00.
Reason:
1.	In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties.
2.	To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of the locality in accordance with policies CC1, CC2 and EQ5 of the adopted Local Plan.

Condition : 5 - The on-site shop shall be permitted to operate on a 24-hour basis for a temporary period of 12 months from the date of this permission.
After the expiry of this 12-month period, the on-site shop shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 07:00 � 23:00.
Reason:
1.	In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties.
2.	To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of the locality in accordance with policies CC1, CC2 and EQ5 of the adopted Local Plan.

Condition : 6 - The development hereby permitted shall be implemented and operated in full accordance with the details, recommendations, and mitigation measures set out in the Noise Assessment prepared by 'Infinity Acoustics' submitted in support of the application.
The approved noise mitigation measures shall be retained, maintained, and operated as approved for the lifetime of the development, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To protect the amenity of nearby occupiers and the surrounding area from noise disturbance.
description: Variation of condition 1 to change the opening hours of the shop for a temporary 12 month period to 24 hours and condition 5 to change the operational times of the petrol pumps for a temporary 12 month period to 24 hours except for pumps 1 to 4 which shall not operate between the hours of 11.00pm and 6.00am.following planning permission 01137/403-405/P29 for the variation of condition 3 to change the opening hours from 07:00 am to 06:00 am following planning permission 01137/403-405/P23 dated 14/12/1983 for erection of petrol service station with car servicing.
